title: Aes3D: Aesthetic Assessment in 3D Gaussian Splatting
abstract: arXiv:2605.05155v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: As 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) gains attention in immersive media and digital content creation, assessing the aesthetics of 3D scenes becomes important in helping creators build more visually compelling 3D content. However, existing evaluation methods for 3D scenes primarily emphasize reconstruction fidelity and perceptual realism, largely overlooking higher-level aesthetic attributes such as composition, harmony, and visual appeal. This limitation comes from two key challenges: (1) the absence of general 3DGS datasets with aesthetic annotations, and (2) the intrinsic nature of 3DGS as a low-level primitive representation, which makes it difficult to capture high-level aesthetic features. To address these challenges, we propose Aes3D, the first systematic framework for assessing the aesthetics of 3D neural rendering scenes. translated_title: Aes3D：3D高斯泼溅中的美学评估
translated_abstract: 随着3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）在沉浸式媒体和数字内容创作领域受到关注，评估3D场景的美学质量对于帮助创作者构建更具视觉吸引力的3D内容变得日益重要。然而，现有的3D场景评估方法主要侧重于重建保真度和感知真实感，在很大程度上忽略了构图、和谐性和视觉吸引力等更高层次的美学属性。这一局限性源于两个关键挑战：（1）缺乏带有美学标注的通用3DGS数据集；（2）3DGS作为低层基元表示的内在特性，使其难以捕获高层审美特征。为了应对这些挑战，我们提出了Aes3D，这是首个用于评估3D神经渲染场景美学的系统性框架。Aes3D包含Aesthetic3D，这是首个专门用于3D场景美学评估的数据集，该数据集基于我们的……（摘要内容不完整，此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出首个系统性的3D场景美学评估框架Aes3D，并构建了首个专门的3D场景美学评估数据集Aesthetic3D，克服了3DGS美学标注数据集缺失以及低层基元表示难以捕获高层美学特征的两大挑战。
en_tdlr: Aes3D is the first systematic framework for aesthetic assessment of 3D neural rendering scenes, introducing Aesthetic3D, the first dedicated 3D scene aesthetic assessment dataset, to overcome the challenges of missing aesthetic-annotated 3DGS datasets and the difficulty of capturing high-level aesthetic features from low-level primitive representations.
